title: Vesuvius quiet since 1948 and accumulating energy

tellings.quote: And from 1948 this volcano is not smoking anymore. So, it is accumulating energy.

plain: Mount Vesuvius, the volcano near Naples in Italy, has not smoked since 1948, and so it is "accumulating energy". That is how a researcher named Filippo Biondi, who uses satellite radar to scan beneath ancient sites, puts it, offering it in passing without citing a source. The point, as he tells it, is that the long quiet is not a sign of safety but of pressure building up.
